terbaru.judul: Market Making and Transient Impact in Spot FX
terbaru.pelajaran: Dealers in foreign exchange markets provide bid and ask prices to their clients at which they are happy to buy and sell, respectively.

terbaru.judul: Automated Market Making for Energy Sharing
terbaru.pelajaran: We develop an axiomatic theory for Automated Market Makers (AMMs) in local energy sharing markets and analyze the Markov Perfect Equilibrium of the resulting economy with a Mean-Field Game.

terbaru.judul: Implicit Numerical Scheme for the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman Quasi-Variational Inequality in the Optimal Market-Making Problem with Alpha Signal
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose an implicit time-discretization scheme coupled with a policy iteration algorithm.

terbaru.judul: A Fair, Flexible, Zero-Waste Digital Electricity Market: A First-Principles Approach Combining Automatic Market Making, Holarchic Architectures and Shapley Theory
terbaru.pelajaran: This thesis presents a fundamental rethink of electricity market design at the wholesale and balancing layers.

terbaru.judul: FX Market Making with Internal Liquidity
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we investigate the optimal multi-objective strategy of a market maker with an option to take liquidity on an internal exchange, and draw important qualitative insights for real-world trading.

terbaru.judul: From Competition to Coordination: Market Making as a Scalable Framework for Safe and Aligned Multi-Agent LLM Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce a market-making framework for multi-agent large language model (LLM) coordination that organizes agent interactions as structured economic exchanges.

terbaru.judul: Two Heads are Better than One: Distilling Large Language Model Features Into Small Models with Feature Decomposition and Mixture
terbaru.pelajaran: Based on the observation found by our investigation, we propose Cooperative Market Making (CMM), a novel framework that decouples LLM features across three orthogonal dimensions: layer, task, and data.

terbaru.judul: Option market making with hedging-induced market impact
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper develops a model for option market making in which the hedging activity of the market maker generates price impact on the underlying asset.

terbaru.judul: An Impulse Control Approach to Market Making in a Hawkes LOB Market
terbaru.pelajaran: We study the optimal Market Making problem in a Limit Order Book (LOB) market simulated using a high-fidelity, mutually exciting Hawkes process.

terbaru.judul: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Market Making: Competition without Collusion
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework to study algorithmic collusion in market making.
